name: Sturdy Midstaff
description: Hold the stave in a settled guard across the body, steady qi in the forearms keeping the shaft rigid.

name: Staffglide
description: Follow the opponent's movement with small steps, keeping the stave's tip pointed at the centre line.

name: Keen Jabbing
description: Thrust the stave level at the chest with a pulse of qi running to the tip.

name: Cruel Staffsweep
description: Swing the stave across the body from the shoulder, qi stiffening the shaft just before contact.

name: Stubborn Ironcap
description: Parry a blow with a burst of qi in the shaft and return with a strike on the same line.

name: Perchhasp
description: Wind the stave along the opponent's weapon to bind it for a moment and break its rhythm.

name: Patient Staffgrip
description: Set both hands loosely on the shaft so each can slide freely, qi relaxing the fingers into the grip.

name: Oakflog
description: Slide the rear hand to the butt end and thrust at full length, driving qi into the tip.

name: Brisk Staffend
description: Strike from the middle of the shaft with hands apart, qi spreading evenly along the wood.

name: Ashswat
description: Slide both hands in near the centre and rap short and fast at close range.

name: Rooted Oakstaff
description: Slide the hands to change the width of the guard as the opponent changes range.

name: Lithe Poleturn
description: Slide the rear hand up the shaft and step back, drawing the stave to a shorter guard.

name: Oakbuckle
description: Slide the stave along an incoming weapon and clamp it against the leading hand, qi locking the grip.

name: Grim Rollover
description: Pull the stave through the hands in a quick slide to land a surprise strike from long reach.

name: Ashslap
description: Roll the stave over the shoulder in a looping swing, using the momentum to carry the strike.

name: Ember Rollover
description: Roll the stave behind the back and bring it out from the opposite side in a surprise strike.

name: Scudding Staffshoe
description: Step through a turn while the stave rolls, qi flowing evenly between the feet and hands.

name: Draught Ironcap
description: Roll the stave in the wrists to catch a blow and turn it off to one side.

name: Weighty Poleturn
description: Chain three rolling strikes together in a single smooth sequence, qi driving the rhythm.

name: Brassoak
description: Finish a roll with a heavy downward smash, qi gathering in the arms for the final blow.

name: Binding Rapidspin
description: Catch the opponent's strike on the stave and roll it away, throwing the opponent's weapon off line.

name: Clay Midstaff
description: Roll the stave back to guard after a strike, qi steadying the arms for the next exchange.

name: Perchzip
description: Step away as the stave rolls out across the front, breaking contact cleanly.

name: Brass Nodeknot
description: Settle into the ready stance for the counter-rap, qi held in the arms, tip trained on the opponent's hands.

name: Wild Jabbing
description: Tap the stave sharply against the opponent's leading hand, with a short pulse of qi through the tip.

name: Moment Staffend
description: Rap the opponent's wrist as it rises, stinging it and forcing the weapon off line.

name: Rill Oakstaff
description: Parry a blow upward and tap the wrist on the return, a single movement in two parts.

name: Staffcurl
description: Step back from an attack and rap the weapon hand on the way out, qi quickening the stave's recoil.

name: Dire Staffsweep
description: String quick raps along the opponent's arm from wrist to elbow, driving them back.

name: Static Staffgrip
description: Lock the stave against the opponent's forearm and press down, using qi to hold the lock firm.

name: Rowanslap
description: Rap the weapon aside and thrust through the opening on the next breath.

name: Sturdy Ashwood
description: Settle low with the stave angled down at the legs, qi lowering the weight into the thighs.

name: Honed Midstaff
description: Sweep the stave low and flat at the opponent's shins, qi stiffening the shaft at the moment of impact.

name: Gagging Staffshoe
description: Hook the stave around the ankle and pull to topple an advancing opponent.

name: Regimen Rollover
description: Rap the near knee, then the far knee, forcing the opponent to shift their weight.

name: Oakstalk
description: Hop over a low counter-sweep and land with the stave ready to strike.

name: Brawnoak
description: Follow a low sweep with a rising overhead blow while the opponent's weight is on the back foot.

name: Poise Balancegrip
description: Drop the stave to check an incoming low kick or sweep before it lands.

name: Dense Ironcap
description: Hold the stave with hands wide apart so a cut lands on the middle of the shaft, qi hardening the wood.

name: Hazeperch
description: Angle the shaft against a cutting blow so the edge slides off rather than bites, qi stiffening the arms.

name: Slinking Midstaff
description: Keep just beyond the blade's reach with a careful step and the stave's length, qi in the legs for balance.

name: Rowanflog
description: Use the stave's extra length to rap the opponent's leading hand before the blade comes near.

name: Hum Nodeknot
description: Press the stave against the flat of the blade and bind it, qi locking the grip against the pull.

name: Resolute Oakstaff
description: Meet a downward cut at the strong middle of the shaft and counter-strike on the rebound.

name: Honedstaff
description: Thrust the stave past the opponent's guard, using the stave's length to land first.

name: Viselike Staffshoe
description: Slip the stave into the blade's guard and twist sharply, wrenching the weapon from the grip.

name: Buttressed Ashwood
description: Let a thrust glance along the shaft and slide off the near end, qi easing the arms against the force.

name: Rigid Staffgrip
description: Hold the stave vertically in both hands in a tight lane, qi steadying the arms against being jostled.

name: Staffthwack
description: Thrust the stave short and fast down a narrow passage, qi flaring at the tip.

name: Grit Midstaff
description: Step along a wall with the stave held close, avoiding a swing that would strike the stone.

name: Crimson Oakstaff
description: Bring the stave down in a vertical chop where there is no room to swing wide, qi hardening the shaft.

name: Armored Staffend
description: Parry in the tight space with a short motion of the shaft and return a snap strike.

name: Cramping Staffshoe
description: Press the stave across a doorway to hold the opponent back, qi steadying the arms against the push.

name: Rugged Jabbing
description: Reverse the stave and jab the butt end into the opponent's ribs in a tight space.

name: Sleetoak
description: Take the second guard with the stave held high, tip drooping, qi gathered in the shoulders and ready.

name: Padded Ironcap
description: Parry a blow high and immediately link a strike at the same level in one unbroken motion.

name: Bold Rollover
description: Turn the body on the lead foot and thrust, qi running from the hips through the arms.

name: Ashhurdle
description: Switch the lead foot and the guard together, qi easing the weight from one leg to the other.

name: Vicious Staffspin
description: Strike from a hanging high guard with a sudden drop of the tip, qi quick in the wrists.

name: Weighty Staffsweep
description: Tap the opponent's guard repeatedly in a tight rhythm, qi pulsing through the stave to wear down their arms.

name: Gall Rapidspin
description: Break the opponent's rhythm by pressing the stave against their weapon at the end of an exchange, qi firming the arms.

name: Layered Balancegrip
description: Settle into a steady swaying rhythm with the stave held in guard, qi pacing the breath.

name: Staticash
description: Probe the opponent's reach with a light jab, testing their reaction while qi stays in reserve.

name: Hungry Quarterpoint
description: Beat the opponent's weapon aside with the stave and thrust through the opening, qi quickening the second motion.

name: Prowling Staffend
description: Step back or forward in time with the opponent, keeping the stave's tip just at the edge of reach.

name: Clay Staffspin
description: Pause then strike suddenly in the middle of a steady rhythm, qi surging into the arms.

name: Stalwart Midstaff
description: Delay a parry until the last moment and return with a strike, qi sharpening the timing.

name: Entangling Nodeknot
description: Beat the opponent's weapon and wind the stave around it, qi tightening the grip to hold the bind.

name: Rowanglide
description: Advance with short sliding steps, the stave's tip trained on the target and qi ready.

name: Shard Ironcap
description: Plant the rear foot and angle the stave against the ground ahead, qi hardening the legs for a rushing attacker.

name: Brass Jabbing
description: Meet a charging opponent with a straight thrust to the chest, qi driving the tip.

name: Rillperch
description: Step aside from a rush and strike the opponent's flank as they pass.

name: Poise Staffend
description: Hold the stave level at chest height to bar the path of a charging attacker, qi locking the arms.

name: Tethering Poleturn
description: Slip the stave between the opponent's legs as they rush and twist to trip them.

name: Perchscorer
description: Absorb the force on the braced stave and rebound with a heavy blow, qi surging in the shoulders.

name: Shielding Oakstaff
description: Angle the stave to deflect the charge sideways and let it glance past, qi easing the impact on the arms.

name: Stern Staffspin
description: Sweep the stave low after the charge is turned, qi tightening the arms to put the opponent off balance.
